title: Resolve a primary result or fallback
summary: Use a fallback value if a simulated asynchronous primary lookup fails.
requirements: primary has {ok,value}; when ok=false the primary promise rejects.
Return the result source as primary or fallback together with its value.
A successful primary value of 0 or null must not trigger fallback.
hints: Distinguish a rejected promise from a falsey value.
Await the primary inside try/catch and resolve the fallback only on rejection.
